newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila SEC tells 40 firms to hike shares par value.
newsitem.headline: Manila SEC tells 40 firms to hike shares par value.

text.p: The Philippine Stock Exchange (PSE) said it had ordered 40 listed companies to raise the par value of their shares to at least one peso each so they could be accommodated in the scripless trading system.
PSE chairman Wilson Sy told reporters that a memorandum was issued to remind the companies about the par value change for which the deadline was at the end of next month.
The bourse had given companies one year to increase their par value. Many companies, mostly oil and mining firms, have par value of one centavo apiece. Many of them were issued in the 1970s.
"We want to know if they have made some progress in changing the par value of their stocks," Sy said.
The Philippine bourse recently went scripless and shares require a par value of at least one peso to be eligible for the system.
